# orion serve

Serve the Orion API or report its status

```sh
orion serve <command> [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--port <value>` | HTTP port (default 5198) |
| `--host <value>` | HTTP host (default 127.0.0.1) |
| `--static <value>` | Built app directory |

## orion serve status

Report the running Orion server

```sh
orion serve status [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print JSON |
